Project prerequisites 1.
Government support: The state actively supports the implementation of such projects and provides the following support
measures: - Subsidies for construction and equipment purchase account for up to 40 per cent of capital costs. 1
- Subsidies for fodder purchase up to 15%2
- Preferential VAT rate of 10% 3 2. Growth of aquaculture in the world and Russia: - Commercial aquaculture is the most economical way to produce protein in the world.
- Since 1980, the amount of fish farmed has equalled the amount of fish caught from natural water bodies, and by 2022, more than doubled.
- Domestic production received a significant boost after the introduction of counter-sanctions in 2014. Currently, Russia produces more than 500 thousand tonnes of various fish species per
year, with plans to grow to 700 thousand tonnes by 2030.

blocks.translated_text: Предварительные условия проекта 1. Государственная поддержка: Государство активно поддерживает реализацию таких проектов и обеспечивает следующие меры поддержки: - Субсидии на строительство и приобретение оборудования составляют до 40% капитальных затрат. 1 - Субсидии на приобретение кормов до 15%2 - Преференциальная ставка НДС 10% 3 2. Рост аквакультуры в мире и России: - Коммерческое аквакультура является самым экономичным способом производства белка в мире. - С 1980 года количество рыбы, выращиваемой в аквакультуре, достигло уровня рыбы, выловленной из естественных водоемов, и к 2022 году более чем удвоилось. - После введения контрсанкций в 2014 году отечественное производство получило значительный подъем. В настоящее время Россия производит более 500 тыс. тонн различных видов рыбы в год, и к 2030 году планируется увеличить его до 700 тыс. тонн.

3. Market Needs: - The industry is experiencing a chronic shortage of fish planting material (FPM). For 2023, the figure was more than 20 million pieces per year.
- The majority of rearing in the region is carried out by cage farms in open water bodies, where the business model involves purchasing fry from third-party suppliers.
- A large number of low-quality RPM due to the desire of unscrupulous suppliers to save money when purchasing caviar and feed. This may lead to contamination of the whole farm of the
buyer.

blocks.text:
It is critical to monitor the origin of the RPM and to know what feeds and eggs were used in its 
rearing, as this affects the growth rate and survival of the fish.

It is critical to monitor the origin of the RPM and to know what feeds and eggs were used in its
rearing, as this affects the growth rate and survival of the fish.
blocks.translated_text: Очень важно следить за происхождением РПМ и знать, какие кормления и яйца использовались в его выращивании, поскольку это влияет на темпы роста и выживаемость рыбы.

blocks.text:
Strict control of environmental parameters promotes stable growth of fish and, most importantly, 
reduces the risk of disease. Diseases introduced from open water can spread quickly and cause 
irreparable damage to the customer's entire farm.
blocks.normalized_text:
Strict control of environmental parameters promotes stable growth of fish and, most importantly,
reduces the risk of disease. Diseases introduced from open water can spread quickly and cause
irreparable damage to the customer's entire farm.
blocks.translated_text: Строгий контроль экологических параметров способствует стабильному росту рыб и, что самое главное, снижает риск заболевания.

blocks.text:
Unlike open ponds, where fish are prone to disease and parasites, ROMs provide a controlled and 
safe environment for rearing RPMs. This is especially important in the first stages of fry rearing.
blocks.normalized_text:
Unlike open ponds, where fish are prone to disease and parasites, ROMs provide a controlled and
safe environment for rearing RPMs. This is especially important in the first stages of fry rearing.
blocks.translated_text: В отличие от открытых прудов, где рыбы подвержены болезням и паразитам, РОМ обеспечивают контролируемую и безопасную среду для выращивания РПМ.

blocks.text:
The Fry City project is aimed at creating the largest hatchery complex in the Leningrad Region for 
raising rainbow trout fry. It is designed to solve the problem of rainbow trout RPM deficit, which is 
particularly acute for the North-West region.
blocks.normalized_text:
The Fry City project is aimed at creating the largest hatchery complex in the Leningrad Region for
raising rainbow trout fry. It is designed to solve the problem of rainbow trout RPM deficit, which is
particularly acute for the North-West region.
blocks.translated_text: Проект Fry City направлен на создание крупнейшего в Ленинградской области инкубационного комплекса для выращивания рыжий тростника.

blocks.text:
Despite the fact that 90 per cent of the country's rainbow trout are produced here, the region lacks 
its own planting material. This leads to the need to purchase RPM from other regions, which 
significantly increases the cost of production, and also carries additional risks both during transport 
and during subsequent rearing, as the fish experience tremendous stress during transport.
blocks.normalized_text:
Despite the fact that 90 per cent of the country's rainbow trout are produced here, the region lacks
its own planting material. This leads to the need to purchase RPM from other regions, which
significantly increases the cost of production, and also carries additional risks both during transport
and during subsequent rearing, as the fish experience tremendous stress during transport.
blocks.translated_text: Несмотря на то, что здесь вырабатывается 90 процентов тростника, в регионе не хватает собственного посадочного материала. Это приводит к необходимости приобретать РПМ из других регионов, что значительно увеличивает затраты на производство, а также несет дополнительные риски как во время транспортировки, так и во время последующего выращивания, поскольку рыбы испытывают огромный стресс во время транспортировки.

blocks.text:
The project aims to localise the production of fish planting material, reduce dependence on external 
supplies and create new jobs. 
Together, this will improve food security and strengthen the economic health of the region.
blocks.normalized_text:
The project aims to localise the production of fish planting material, reduce dependence on external
supplies and create new jobs.
Together, this will improve food security and strengthen the economic health of the region.
blocks.translated_text: Цель проекта - локализовать производство рыбных материалов, сократить зависимость от внешних поставок и создать новые рабочие места, что вместе повысит продовольственную безопасность и укрепит экономическое здоровье региона.

blocks.text:
The availability of a ready infrastructure, professional team and in-house contracting organisation 
guarantees efficient project management and quick market entry.
blocks.normalized_text:
The availability of a ready infrastructure, professional team and in-house contracting organisation
guarantees efficient project management and quick market entry.
blocks.translated_text: Наличие готовой инфраструктуры, профессиональной команды и внутренней организации заказчиков гарантирует эффективное управление проектами и быстрый доступ к рынку.

blocks.text:
In addition, the use of CPI in the infrastructure of a company engaged in the production of 
commercial trout for the subsequent cultivation of commercial fish and caviar will save about 25 
million rubles annually, based on the need for fish planting material of 1,000,000 pieces. 
This will significantly reduce costs and increase the profitability of current production volumes.
blocks.normalized_text:
In addition, the use of CPI in the infrastructure of a company engaged in the production of
commercial trout for the subsequent cultivation of commercial fish and caviar will save about 25
million rubles annually, based on the need for fish planting material of 1,000,000 pieces.
This will significantly reduce costs and increase the profitability of current production volumes.
blocks.translated_text: Кроме того, использование КПИ в инфраструктуре компании, занимающейся производством коммерческого форела для последующего выращивания коммерческой рыбы и кавияра, позволит сэкономить около 25 миллионов рублей в год, исходя из потребности в материалах для выращивания рыбы в размере 1 000 000 штук. Это значительно снизит затраты и повысит рентабельность текущих объемов производства.

blocks.text:
In addition, the opportunity to receive government compensation of 40 per cent of capital costs and 
significantly reduce operating costs in aquaculture will accelerate the payback period of the project.
blocks.normalized_text:
In addition, the opportunity to receive government compensation of 40 per cent of capital costs and
significantly reduce operating costs in aquaculture will accelerate the payback period of the project.
blocks.translated_text: Кроме того, возможность получения государственной компенсации в размере 40% капитальных затрат и значительное сокращение эксплуатационных затрат в аквакультуре ускорит срок возврата проекта.
